  "title": "Expose amp-consent states to 3p iframes",
  "body": "With `amp-consent`,  AMP elements can be configured to be blocked at build time to wait for user interaction with the consent dialog.\r\n\r\nThe consent state is readable by extensions, but not yet accessible from within iframes, use cases includes `amp-ad` and `amp-iframe`.\r\n\r\nHere we propose additions to the window.context API: \r\n\r\n- context.initialConsentState\r\n- context.getConsentStateAsync() // the state can change\r\n\r\n/cc @keithwrightbos @jasti ",
